data.summary: Kfz-Versicherung Beispielsicher AG writes about the deer collision (Wildunfall) reported on 9 November 2026 for vehicle MQ-BQ 207 under claim number KS-26-1109-218. To process the partial comprehensive (Teilkasko) claim, they need the game damage certificate from the hunting lease holder or police plus the completed claim questionnaire, to be returned within 13 working days of the letter's date (21 November 2026).
data.explanation: Your car insurer needs proof of the deer collision and a filled-in claim form to process your partial comprehensive (Teilkasko) claim. Get a certificate from the hunting lease holder (Jagdpächter) or the police confirming the wildlife collision, complete the enclosed questionnaire, and send both back to the insurer by the deadline shown in the app. If you miss it, processing of your claim may be delayed, so it's worth following up with the insurer if you can't meet it in time.
